## Data Validation

### Initialise
Library imports
```{python}
#Import packages
import pandas as pd

#Utils
import src.utils.runtime as util
import src.utils.network as net
```

Load runtime settings
```{python}
settings = util.load_settings()
```

### Load the data
From the sandpit data

```{python}
#Connect to DB
engine = net.db_connect(settings["sql_dsn"], settings["sql_database"])

query_pull = (
    f"SELECT * FROM "
    f"[{settings["sql_database"]}]."
    f"[{settings["sql_destination_schema"]}]."
    f"[{settings["sql_destination_table"]}]"
)
df_main = net.load_data(settings, query_pull, src_type="query", engine=engine)

#Remove ccr columns
df_main = df_main.drop(columns=["ccr_lower", "ccr_upper"])

#Remove admission time due to poor completeness
df_main = df_main.drop("admission_time", axis=1)
```

### Completeness check (Overall)

Describe data pull
```{python}
df_main.describe()
```

How many rows contain a null value
```{python}
rows_with_null = df_main.isnull().any(axis=1).sum()
percentage = (rows_with_null / len(df_main)) * 100
print(percentage)
```

Which columns have the most missing data
```{python}
completeness = (df_main.notnull().sum() / len(df_main)) * 100
summary_df = completeness.to_frame(name='Completeness %')

summary_df
```

Observation: 6% of rows have a NULL Trim days value
Analysis:
- Some regular attendance codes are labelled as daycase for the intended management (LA97B [GOSH Reporting])
- Some HRG Codes are to identify when the treatment was not carried out or failed (WH50x, WH01C)
- Some activity are for maternity (NZxxx) or Mental Health Disorders (WDxxx, PT52x, PT53x) or COVID (DXxxx)
- Some activity are for new treatments with no established trim points (SA - Peripheral Blood Stem Cell and Bone Marrow Transplant)
- Some codes seem like they should have codes and do in previous years (AA82Z)
- BZ35x - Bilateral Cataract, exception due to multiple possible treatments with difference in serverity and risk
- PD13x - Paediatric Cystic Fibrosis, funded directly by NHSE so does not appear in the trim point data.
- WH21x, WH22x - Intoxication is too low impact to introduct trim points for these HRGs
Action: 
- Filter out activity with no HRG Trim point for 24/25
- Explore reason for missing AA82Z trim point in the latest year
```{python}
df_ob1 = df_main[df_main["hrg_trim_days_el"].isna()]

#Filter out HRG Codes without trim points
ob1_filter = ["LA97B", "WH50A", "WH50B", "BZ35A", "BZ35B", "AA82Z", "PT52A", "PT53A", "WH01C"]
df_ob1 = df_ob1[~df_ob1["hrg_code"].isin(ob1_filter)]
#Filter out Maternity activity
df_ob1 = df_ob1[~df_ob1["hrg_code"].str.startswith("NZ")]
#Filter out Mental Health activity
df_ob1 = df_ob1[~df_ob1["hrg_code"].str.startswith("WD")]
#Filter out COVID activity
df_ob1 = df_ob1[~df_ob1["hrg_code"].str.startswith("DX")]
#Filter out Paediatric Cystic Fibrosis activity
df_ob1 = df_ob1[~df_ob1["hrg_code"].str.startswith("PD13")]
#Filter out Acute Drug Intoxication
df_ob1 = df_ob1[~df_ob1["hrg_code"].str.startswith("WH22")]
#Filter out Acute Alcohol Intoxication
df_ob1 = df_ob1[~df_ob1["hrg_code"].str.startswith("WH21")]


#Filter out Peripheral Blood Stem Cell and Bone Marrow Transplant activity
##Note: This would filter out other activity in the main dataframe
df_ob1 = df_ob1[~df_ob1["hrg_code"].str.startswith("SA")]

#With the above filters, only few one-off cases remain. 
#Can safely reduce this by filtering out data with a NULL trim point but need to
#explore AA82Z

#df_ob1
```

Observation: 10% of data contains a NULL value for the count of cormorbidities
Analysis:
- Only 1 diagnosis: Since comorbidities only considers the non-primary diagnosis, if the patient only has a single diagnosis there are no rows in the icd table to join with for the aggregation [Solve by setting such instances to comorbidities = 0, cc_score = 0]
- UZ01Z: Data with this HRG Code ("Data Invalid for Grouping") do not have diagnoses by definition. Can either filter this HRG out or treat it as activity with no comorbidites
  
Action:
- Set count_comorbidites and cc_score to 0 when NULL
- Review inclusion of the UZ01Z HRG Code

```{python}
df_ob2 = df_main.copy()

df_ob2.loc[(
    pd.isna(df_ob2["count_comorbidities"]), 
    ["count_comorbidities", "cc_score"]
    )] = 0

df_ob2.head()
```

Observation: Site level metrics (site_beds, smart_mo) only have a completeness of 65-70%. This is because these metrics have no associated values for the non-major sites.
```{python}
df_ob3 = df_main.copy()

df_ob3 = df_ob3[["provider_code", "site_code", "site_beds_open", "smart_mo", "los"]]

df_ob3.groupby(["provider_code", "site_code"]).agg({
    "site_beds_open": ["size", "mean"],
    "smart_mo": ["mean"],
    "los": ["mean"]
})
```
